##### Project general facts

Azizi Neila by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building designed for a peaceful yet well-connected urban lifestyle. A modern architectural style with clean lines and light tones gives the building an elegant, welcoming appearance within a calm, established neighbourhood. It rises from a ground floor and two podium levels to nine residential floors, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool with a poolside terrace and changing cabins, a modern gym and a children's play area for an active family routine. Landscaped walking paths, open green areas, outdoor relaxation and social zones offer calm places to unwind, while cafes, restaurants and retail outlets bring everyday convenience to the doorstep, complemented by a welcoming lobby, lifts, parking and round-the-clock video surveillance.

Residences are finished in a neutral colour palette with high-quality materials, while spacious layouts and panoramic windows ensure plenty of natural light throughout the day. Efficient floor plans suit young professionals, couples and investors seeking practical homes. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is an established family-friendly community in western Dubai, known for its mix of villas, townhouses and low-rise apartment buildings in Arabic, Mediterranean and contemporary styles. Landscaped parks, playgrounds, sports courts, cycling and jogging tracks and community retail centres with cafes, supermarkets and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a calm, green character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Discovery Gardens metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall and the Jebel Ali Free Zone are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Palm Jumeirah and Expo City Dubai are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, Business Bay and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular addresses in western Dubai. Metro access, mature infrastructure and proximity to Dubai Marina and the Jebel Ali Free Zone attract young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy. Compact studios and one-bedroom homes at competitive prices underpin steady rental demand, attractive yields and long-term value for investors.
